## slide.setLayout [#slide.setLayout]

**Set layout.** Moves a content slide to another layout and refiles its blocks: to freeform the slide converts to the canvas, every block getting the position box it is drawn at (measured); from freeform the boxes are dropped and the blocks fall into the target slots by geometry (docs/freeform.md).

| Field          | Type                                                     | Required | Description                                                      |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `slideId`      | string                                                   | yes      |                                                                  |
| `layout`       | object \| object \| object \| object \| object \| object | yes      | The target layout with its options                               |
| `baseRevision` | integer                                                  | yes      | The revision the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409 |

- Command line: `turboslide slide set-layout <slideId> --type <type> --ratio <ratio> --gap <gap> --layout <layout>`
- MCP tool: `deck_set_layout`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/slide.setLayout`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes; send the `baseRevision` you read.

## slide.new [#slide.new]

**New slide.** Inserts one slide made from a layout with empty placeholders after the named slide (or first in the section), as one slide.insert with template set; a Section header starts a new section that takes the slides after the anchor.

| Field          | Type             | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| -------------- | ---------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `layout`       | one of 22 values | yes      | One of the layout list                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `after`        | string           | no       | The slide the new one follows; first in the section when absent                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `sectionId`    | string           | no       | The section; the anchor's section, or the last section, when absent                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `id`           | string           | no       | The slide id; \<layout\>-\<n\> with the first free n when absent. A browser tab mints \<layout\>-\<n\>-\<four base36 characters of its client id\>, so two tabs adding a slide within the same moment never mint one id (docs/archive/rounds/POLISH.md 2.8 item 99) |
| `baseRevision` | integer          | yes      | The revision the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

- Command line: `turboslide slide new --layout <layout> --after <after> --section <sectionId> --id <id>`
- MCP tool: `deck_new_slide`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/slide.new`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes; send the `baseRevision` you read.

## slide.skip [#slide.skip]

**Skip slide.** Sets or clears skip on the named slides in one write: a skipped slide is left out of the slideshow, the shared view, the downloads and the print unless asked.

## slide.applyLayout [#slide.applyLayout]

**Apply layout.** Applies a layout to the named slides in one write, one slide.replace per slide: the title, the body, the lists, the tables and the pictures move into the matching placeholders and the rest is appended; only a Title slide or a Main point drops what does not fit, and the output names the dropped blocks.

| Field          | Type             | Required | Description                                                      |
| -------------- | ---------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `slideIds`     | string[]         | yes      | One or more slide ids                                            |
| `layout`       | one of 22 values | yes      | One of the layout list                                           |
| `baseRevision` | integer          | yes      | The revision the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409 |

- Command line: `turboslide slide apply-layout <slideIds> <layout>`
- MCP tool: `deck_apply_layout`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/slide.applyLayout`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes; send the `baseRevision` you read.

## slide.import [#slide.import]

**Import slides.** Copies slides from another deck after the named slide in one write: the assets they use are copied into this deck, colliding slide ids are renamed, and the output lists the slides and the assets that came over.

| Field          | Type     | Required | Description                                                         |
| -------------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sourceDeckId` | string   | yes      | The deck the slides come from                                       |
| `slideIds`     | string[] | yes      | The slides to copy, in the order they land                          |
| `after`        | string   | no       | The slide the copies follow; first in the section when absent       |
| `sectionId`    | string   | no       | The section; the anchor's section, or the last section, when absent |
| `baseRevision` | integer  | yes      | The revision the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409    |

- Command line: `turboslide slide import <sourceDeckId> <slideIds> --after <after> --section <sectionId>`
- MCP tool: `deck_import_slides`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/slide.import`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes; send the `baseRevision` you read.

## slide.setBackgroundPicture [#slide.setBackgroundPicture]

**Background picture.** One write for a covering picture object at the back of each named slide with an optional dither, replacing the covering picture already there unless told not to; the file, url and upload forms run asset.add server side first.

| Field          | Type     | Required | Description                                                            |
| -------------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `slideIds`     | string[] | yes      | One or more slide ids                                                  |
| `assetId`      | string   | no       |                                                                        |
| `file`         | string   | no       | A path on the machine, or a data: URL                                  |
| `url`          | string   | no       | An http(s) URL fetched through safeFetch                               |
| `upload`       | string   | no       | Hosted: the key of a presigned client upload                           |
| `alt`          | string   | no       |                                                                        |
| `dither`       | object   | no       |                                                                        |
| `replace`      | boolean  | no       | Replace the covering picture at the bottom of the stack; on unless set |
| `baseRevision` | integer  | yes      | The revision the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409       |

- Command line: `turboslide slide background-picture <slideIds> --asset <assetId> --file <file> --url <url> --alt <alt> --dither --no-replace`
- MCP tool: `deck_set_slide_background_picture`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/slide.setBackgroundPicture`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes; send the `baseRevision` you read.

## slide.setBackgroundMaterial [#slide.setBackgroundMaterial]

**Background material.** Captures a shader material at an anchor and places the frozen frame as a covering picture object at the back of each named slide with an optional dither, in one call, or stores the frame the client sends with `frame` without a render; server side.

| Field          | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| -------------- | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `slideIds`     | string[] | yes      | One or more slide ids                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `materialId`   | string   | yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `preset`       | string   | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `uniforms`     | record   | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `anchor`       | number   | no       | The frame time in ms; the catalog default unless set                                                                                                                                                |
| `dither`       | object   | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `frame`        | object   | no       | The frame the editor drew in its own WebGL at the sheet’s aspect (3200 by 1800); with it no browser launches in the function and the bytes are stored under the key derived id the block frames use |
| `baseRevision` | integer  | yes      | The revision the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409                                                                                                                                    |

- Command line: `turboslide slide background-material <slideIds> <materialId> --preset <preset> --anchor <anchor> --dither`
- MCP tool: `deck_set_slide_background_material`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/slide.setBackgroundMaterial`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes; send the `baseRevision` you read.
